items.name: Iron repletion (oral, therapeutic dose)
checks_blockers: Ferritin 7.5 with documented bleeding signals (gums, nasal mucus) + unscreened GI/parasitic risk (rural Bihar/Thailand travel, never stool-tested). High-dose iron must NOT be self-started before the CAUSE is worked up — masking a bleeding source is dangerous. Physician + stool occult blood + parasite screen FIRST.
items.alternative_if_blocked: Until physician clearance: maximise dietary/absorption levers only (reintroduce red meat 1-2x/week, vitamin C with iron meals, move coffee away from meals). Then physician-chosen iron (often ferrous bisglycinate, gentler) at a supervised dose, retest ferritin at 8-12 weeks.

items.name: Omega-3 (fish oil, 2 caps/day — current)
checks_warnings: Fish oil is not shellfish, so usually tolerated by shellfish-allergic people — BUT given documented ANAPHYLAXIS to crustaceans and his dislike of fish, switch to ALGAL omega-3 (EPA+DHA) to remove all doubt. Verify current product's EPA+DHA content; for his lipid picture target ≥1.5-2 g combined EPA+DHA/day.
items.alternative_if_blocked: Algal omega-3, ~1g+ DHA + EPA/day (e.g., Unived/Bryté algal omega-3)

items.name: Whey protein — ISOLATE only (MuscleBlaze Biozyme Isolate, current)
checks_passed: Lactose intolerance: ISOLATE is correct (concentrate is blocked for him — he confirms concentrate causes severe bloating). Continue isolate; never switch to concentrate/blend.
checks_warnings: Confirm the SKU is a true isolate, not a concentrate blend.

items.name: Vitamin D3 60,000 IU/week (current, continuing)
checks_warnings: He is ALREADY at 63 ng/mL (top of optimal 40-60). Continuing a weekly LOADING dose indefinitely risks pushing into excess (>100). Step DOWN to maintenance: 60,000 IU once a MONTH, or ~2,000 IU/day. Recheck 25-OH at week 12.

items.name: Creatine monohydrate (current)
checks_passed: No renal disease (eGFR 101). No drug interaction. Dose ~3-5g/day standard. Continue — supports his training + cognition goal.

items.name: Magnesium glycinate (current, 2 caps)
checks_passed: Serum Mg 1.98 (just below optimal). Glycinate is the right form for sleep. No interaction. Continue, take in the evening.

items.name: Vitamin C 500mg (current — REPURPOSE)
checks_passed: No oxalate/renal contraindication. Reposition timing: take WITH iron-containing meals to boost non-heme absorption rather than as a standalone AM dose.

items.name: B12 / folate sources (Recalmin-XT + NVMe + multivitamin — current)
checks_warnings: Not unsafe, but THREE overlapping B12/folate sources explain B12 >2000 and folate >24. Consolidate to a single source to avoid pointless stacking. Note: high B12 can mask interpretation; not harmful. Also note Recalmin-XT contains calcium — do NOT co-time with iron meals (calcium competes).

items.name: Soluble-fibre / psyllium (proposed for lipids)
checks_passed: No GI obstruction. Start low, take with adequate water. Supports ApoB/LDL lowering and gut regularity.

items.name: Any NSAID-based recovery supplement
checks_blockers: NSAID allergy (ibuprofen/Combiflam). Avoid all NSAID-containing recovery aids. For soreness use his physician-approved Zerodol SP sparingly, ice, and load management instead.

items.name: Caffeine / pre-workout (Monster Zero, occasional)
checks_warnings: Fine occasionally. Keep caffeine away from iron meals and >8-10h before his 10pm bedtime (he wakes 5:45 — protect the already-short 6h sleep). Avoid the after-lunch coffee specifically (iron + sleep).
